rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: # Pathogens and diseases: malaria, dengue, filariasis, ascariasis, pneumonia, typhoid, tuberculosis, common cold, AIDS, ringworm ## 1. Introduction Opening frame for **Pathogens and diseases** — what the topic is, why it matters, a real-world hook (Nepal where possible), the map of what follows, and the learning outcomes (biology-plan.md §3.1, block I).…  ·  A **pathogen** is any organism or agent that causes disease — viruses, bacteria, protozoa, helminth worms and fungi. For every disease in the NEB list you need five facts: the pathogen (with its type), how it spreads, the main symptom, how it is diagnosed, and how it is prevented or treated. The tables below carry all five columns for all ten diseases.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Vector table — malaria: Plasmodium via female Anopheles; dengue: dengue virus via female Aedes; filariasis: Wuchereria via Culex; typhoid: Salmonella typhi (contaminated food/water); ascariasis: Ascaris (fecal-oral); pneumonia: Streptococcus/Diplococcus.  ·  Trick 2: Symptoms one-liners: malaria — recurring chill and fever (every 48 h for P. vivax); typhoid — step-ladder fever, Widal test; filariasis — elephantiasis (lymph swelling).
